question: Should ClawSweeper adopt this release-contract and advisory classification model as the foundation for release-train reporting?
rationale: The code is intentionally non-mutating, but it creates durable release metadata, classification, and provenance policy that cannot be accepted from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Sponsor advisory foundation
options.body: Approve the read-only contract and collector while retaining separate approval gates for publishing, checks, and enforcement.

options.title: Revise the release contract
options.body: Request narrower metadata or classification rules before accepting them as ClawSweeper policy.

options.title: Defer release-control
options.body: Pause this rollout and keep the existing release process unchanged until maintainers prioritize the capability.

recommendation.title: Sponsor advisory foundation
recommendation.body: Approve the read-only contract and collector while retaining separate approval gates for publishing, checks, and enforcement.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository steward and current release publisher, Peter is the strongest available owner for this cross-repository release-policy decision.
